name: adminLockoutThresholdCount
definition: The number of failed administrator logins before lockout (Device > Setup > Management > Authentication Settings). 0 means lockout is off.
population: the global administrator lockout setting of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management authentication settings showing a numeric failed-attempts value.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: 0 means lockout is off, which is the weakest setting although it is the lowest number: write a requirement as a range (greaterThan 1 and lessThan N), never lessThan alone. deviceconfig/setting/management/admin-lockout/failed-attempts (0 to 10) from the CLI hierarchy. Per-authentication-profile lockout settings are not read; an absent setting is Not evaluated, not 0, because the default is not evidenced.
